title: ClassificationResult v1
description: Structured output of the classification agent for a single consolidated health event.

classification.description: Exactly one classification for the event.

reason.description: At least one sentence explaining the classification with reference to specific event content.

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the earliest customer-impacting action deadline, or null.

deadline_basis.description: The exact quoted phrase from the event description that provided the deadline.

verification_steps.description: Concrete steps for the operator to verify or act on this event.

notes_for_operator.description: Additional context that does not fit in the reason field.
